item.title: Two members of a fishing crew airlifted by Valentia Coast Guard
item.description: Two members of a fishing crew have been airlifted by Valentia Coast Guard. Two men were seriously injured after an accident on board and are currently being transported to hospital. The incident happened at around 9:12 this morning, 30 miles off the coast of Valentia. Advertisement

item.title: Squad Depth the Key Throughout Dingle Journey
item.description: Dingle are embracing the excitement ahead of their AIB All-Ireland Senior Club Football Championship Final. Following comeback victories against St Finbarr’s and Ballyboden, the Kerry and Munster champions now stand one game away from national glory. They face St Brigid’s of Roscommon this Sunday at Croke Park, with throw-in at 3.40pm. item.title: Fisherman dies off Valentia coast, second man seriously injured
item.description: A fisherman has died off the Valentia coast, and another man is seriously injured. It's understood both men were injured when a rope snapped on board their boat, a Spanish fishing vessel. Valentia Coast Guard received the alert from its counterpart in Spain at around 12 minutes past 9 this morning. item.description: Mary Scanlon formerly of Tenekilla, Ballyhahill and late of 8 Corbry Estate, Glin, Co. Limerick passed away peacefully on the 14th January 2026 in the loving care of the staff of Camilla Ward St. Ita's Nursing Home, Newcastlewest, Co. Limerick. Mary is predeceased by her parents Maurice and Catherine Mary Scanlon and her sister Joan. item.title: Five Kerry projects have been shortlisted for a national award
item.description: Five Kerry projects have been shortlisted for a national award that showcases local initiatives, individuals, and contributions to the community. Nominations for the All-Ireland Community and Council Awards were put forward by Kerry County Council. This year 31 local authorities across Ireland are nominated over 533 projects in 24 categories, with Kerry County Council associated initiatives nominated in five. item.title: Residents near blackspot N22 junction tell meeting they see danger there every day
item.description: People living near the Poulgorm junction off the main Kerry to Cork road have told Killarney councillors they see danger there every single day. Independent councillor Maura Healy-Rae brought a deputation from residents of Clonkeen, Clydagh, and Glenflesk to the recent Killarney Municipal District meeting. item.title: Court hearing final statements in trial of Kerry humanitarian worker in Greece
item.description: Final statements are being heard in court in the trial of a Kerry man in Greece. Seán Binder, who grew up in Castlegregory, is standing trial at the Court of Appeal in Lesvos, Greece, along with 23 other migrant rescue volunteers. He faces charges including membership of a criminal organisation, money laundering, and smuggling, and faces up to 20 years in prison on conviction. item.title: One crewman dies and other critically injured in accident on fishing vessel off Valentia coast
item.description: One man has died and another is believed to be in a serious condition, following an incident on a fishing boat off Valentia coast earlier today. The air lifting of the injured man - in very challenging sea conditions - involved two helicopters and a fixed wing plane. The alarm was raised this morning when Valentia Coastguard was alerted by its counterpart in Madrid, and told that two men had been injured on a Spanish fishing vessel. item.title: Greek court acquits Seán Binder of all charges
item.description: A Greek court has acquitted Seán Binder of charges against him including money laundering and smuggling. Mr Binder, who grew up in Castlegregory, was standing trial at the Court of Appeal in Lesvos, along with 23 other migrant rescue volunteers. Amnesty International said Mr Binder’s human rights had been violated and that defending human rights should be protected and celebrated, not punished.
